description: RR-100: the CI evidence that scripts/ci-evidence.mjs requires for a release commit (the publish workflow, before npm publish) and that opf's release-train.mjs tag reads. This repository has no merge queue, so the evidence is the push-to-main run of ci.yml on exactly the release commit: its package job(s) and the Node 22 and Node 26 engines-range legs. Keep the job names equal to ci.yml's.
